summary: DisplayMagician is stronger for NVIDIA Surround, AMD Eyefinity, cloned displays, and unusual display hardware. SimLauncher is stronger as a large game and companion-app launcher, with 27 sims, drag-to-reorder, and launch delays. PitLaunch is the whole-PC Desk ↔ Rig switcher: displays, audio, window positions, apps, hardware readiness, game detection, Discord, Stream Deck, safety, and recovery move as one setup.
verification: PitLaunch 1.0 behavior in this comparison was verified locally on the launch machine. Competitor strengths are fair summaries of their official documentation and were not hardware-tested here.
